pages.text: The Mixer combines item and fluid ingredients into new products.$(br)$(br)Put item ingredients in Item Input Hatches and fluids in Fluid Input Hatches. Collect products from the matching output hatches and provide energy through an Energy Input Hatch.

pages.title: Construction
pages.text: 5 × 5 × 6 compact driven vessel, replacing a 12 × 5 × 10 gantry. A top drive and central service shaft read as an agitator. Three distinct fluid feeds face west; low east item/fluid discharge stays accessible. The controller sits in a one-block front recess.$(br)$(br)2 drive, 15 frame, 4 framed glass, 11 panel, 7 pipe, 26 vessel, 2 vent. Plus the controller and 7 hatches shown in the preview.$(br)$(br)Only the current guide layout forms. Retired 2.5 layouts and the 2.6 Habitat require rebuilding. Finish active cycles and empty hatches before updating; do not break a loaded controller or hatch. NsTut Lib 0.8.2 Smart Hammer replaces supported ordinary blocks inside the current pattern and returns their items. Recover unsupported hatches and resource-bearing or compound blocks manually first; surplus blocks outside the pattern remain.
